items.title: We have been working on how often safeguards intervene.
items.title_zh: We have been working on how often safeguards intervene.
items.description: We have been working on how often safeguards intervene. Our latest biology safeguards intervene on benign requests 85% less often than the ones we shipped with Fable 5, and Claude Code users should see around 60% fewer cyber interventions…

items.title: There’s a lot of alpha in making your agents *less annoying*.
items.title_zh: There’s a lot of alpha in making your agents *less annoying*.
